lines.text: You could be so much better than this. And deep down, you know it.
You know exactly what you should be doing.
You just haven't done it yet.
You scroll for hours, then say you don't have time.
You wait to feel ready. But ready never comes.
You want the results, but not the routine.
So here's what you're going to do.
You're going to wake up when you said you would.
You're going to do the hard thing first.
And you're going to keep the promises you make to yourself.
Because nobody is coming to do it for you.
The version of you that you keep imagining?
